narrative_purpose: Visualizes Earnshaw instability: a small block balanced precariously on the peak of a smooth magnetic potential dome, showing an unstable equilibrium where any lateral displacement slides away.
subject: A smooth luminous dome-shaped potential surface against a dark void. A single dark geometric block perches precariously at the exact summit of the dome, tilted slightly off-center. Faint ghosted silhouettes of the block appear further down the curved slopes on both sides, showing the trajectory of an unstable slip. No drawn arrows or diagram lines.
scene: An isolated physics thought-experiment space: the glowing contour of the dome and the sliding block against deep void space.
camera: Head-on three-quarter elevation showing the curvature of the dome and the precarious balance at its peak.
light: The dome surface and block contours emit a soft cyan luminescence against deep shadows.
palette: Near-black void base, luminous cyan potential surface, deep teal block with subtle magenta highlight on the ghosted slip positions.
style: Speculative-physics painterly illustration plate, soft luminous surfaces on dark void.
detail_level: Smooth curved dome surface, clearly defined apex block, soft ghosted sliding positions.
composition: Dome centered in lower half, apex block at upper-middle, symmetrical curved slopes falling to both lower corners.
consistency_notes: Adheres to the pure visual art standard. All force vectors, labels, and annotations are handled dynamically by DiagramFigure in the web interface.
negative_prompt: no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows, no vector diagram lines, no photorealism, no 3D bevels, no clutter
